items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: And then I later talked to Neal Hefti a lot about the great Woody Herman band

ctx.x: But he said all those great old things that have come up, were things that guys in the band made up — “Sing Sing Sing” of Benny Goodman’s was mainly head I was told. Some of it was written out but they added things. And then I later talked to Neal Hefti a lot about the great Woody Herman band that made “Apple Honey” and “Caledonia” and all those things. And those things were head arrangements.
Neal came and played his trumpet with me last Sunday night.
